One value, 49 times: the CI-only API_KEY_ENCRYPTION_KEY (prefixed `ci-`) set in .github/workflows/tests.yml (x2) and copied into 17 files under docs/plans/ (x47). A test-workflow fixture, not a deployment credential.
.env.example:14 - JWT_SECRET is empty; the match runs onto the next line's variable name.

Django rule on a FastAPI + Jinja app. Both auth cookies (admin_token, user_token) are set HttpOnly + SameSite=Lax, which browsers withhold on cross-site POST; the admin router's writes are POST (39 routes) or DELETE (1); the developer dashboard adds a double-submit CSRF token checked with secrets.compare_digest. Scope: the rule inspects POST forms only; GET handlers that set cookies or write rows (Lax does not cover top-level GET navigations) were not traced in this curation.
Same-rule flood across six workflows (tests, docs, codeql, bandit, deploy, semgrep): SHA-pinning third-party actions is supply-chain hardening, not a vulnerability.
website/docs/api/websocket/{booth,captions}.mdx:16 - a ws:// URL in API documentation text, not code.

home.html:11 + listener-event.html:4 load the Tailwind Play CDN script (cdn.tailwindcss.com), which is unversioned and cannot carry an SRI hash. Vendoring a Tailwind build removes the third-party script; the project already did so for its error pages in #263.
email_sender.py:76 renders email/onboarding.html through Starlette's Jinja2Templates, whose environment uses select_autoescape() (starlette 1.1.0 templating.py:95) - .html templates are escaped.
webhooks.py:80 - SQLAlchemy performance lint, not a security rule.

embed-player.js:189 headless-embed listener: enforces the configured allowed_origins list when set and requires source='voxbento-parent'; it can only play, pause or set the volume of the embedded audio - the control surface an embeddable player is meant to give its host page.
tts/worker.py:51 logs 'Deepgram API key not found for Event <id>' - the event id, never the key.
Dockerfile + floor-bot/Dockerfile run as root; a USER line is container hardening, not a vulnerability.
Dockerfile + floor-bot/Dockerfile: image-size hygiene.

starlette 1.1.0 -> 1.3.1 in uv.lock (transitive via fastapi 0.141.1, which requires only starlette>=0.46.0). request.form() limits are ignored for urlencoded bodies; reachable before login through the FastAPI Form() parameters on the auth routes. No open Dependabot PR at scan time (starlette is transitive). Fix: uv lock --upgrade-package starlette.
